newsitem.title: GERMANY: Berlin Santas protest against welfare cuts.
newsitem.headline: Berlin Santas protest against welfare cuts.

text.p: About 100 bearded Santas and a few frozen angels marched through Berlin's icy streets on Saturday to protest against the government's programme of welfare cuts.
The protesters, students at Berlin's Technical University, were objecting to parliament's decision last October to make them pay pension contributions on the jobs they take to finance their studies.

The student angels and Santa Clauses traditionally hire themselves out to sing carols to families and entertain children on Christmas Eve. So far, the Christmas merriment counts as part-time work and is still exempt from the austerity programme.
